title: Verb List (Actions to Relate to a Page)
summary: Richard Serra's column of transitive verbs, each wired to the live browser operation it names, performed on the page's own body.
mechanism: A menu of transitive verbs (to twist, to smear, to scatter, to remove) each triggers its literal CSS transform/filter or DOM mutation on the slab, accumulating per click; reload resets, no storage, no network.
references: Richard Serra, Verb List Compilation: Actions to Relate to Oneself (1967-68)
net.art (CSS transforms and the DOM as material)
